# Altitude
A recently-pushed update to shuttle consoles has caused the concept of "the sky" to become something pilots must worry about on planets.
When on a planet, a few new values will appear on your shuttle console; namely, your heave velocity (vertical velocity, in layman's terms), and your current altitude.
In order to move up and down levels, the default keys are [color=green]R[/color] and [color=green]F[/color] respectively.
Mind that while flying between levels, you can crash into a shuttle between you and where you're falling. [italic][color=red]This will lead to you and whoever you're hitting having a you-sized hole in their hull.[/color][/italic]
